title: How Does God Prove His Love?
question: When did God show His love for us, and what did it cost Him?
blurb: God didn't wait for us to clean up first. See the timing and the cost that proved His love.

nodes.content: When did God show His love for us, and what did it cost Him?

nodes.verseText: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

nodes.content: The proof is in the timing: 'while we were still sinners.' God's love came first, before we had earned anything or turned back to Him.

nodes.verseText: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

nodes.content: Romans 5:8 sets two things side by side: our condition ('sinners') and God's response ('Christ died for us'). The cross is where His love is demonstrated, not merely declared.
